args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the documented requirement
(and tests/test_money.py) expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the documented behavior and `tests/test_money.py` expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin212` passed.

## Example
- `2.675` → `2.68` (rounds half up to even tie-breaking as expected)
- `2.665` → `2.66` (ties round to even)
